sections.title: The Hook: Dynamics in Motion
lecture_lines: Change defines our world, not just static values.
Observe the rabbit population growth over time.
Population speed relates to its current size.
animations: Fade in title 'Rabbit Population Dynamics' in '#FFFFFF' at top.
Animate a rabbit icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rabbit.svg] and population counter 'N' (color: '#00FF00').
Show speedometer graphic [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speedometer.svg] for 'dN/dt' (color: '#FF0000') and Flash both simultaneously.

sections.title: What is an ODE?
lecture_lines: An ODE links a function to its derivative.
We solve for functions, not just numbers.
Take this exponential growth model, for example.
animations: Split screen: show 'Function y = f(x)' (color: '#FFFF00') using icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bacteria.svg] and 'ODE dy/dx = f'(x)' (color: '#00FFFF').
Animate a parabola on the left and tangent arrows on the right.

Flash connecting line between tangent arrow and parabola slope to show relationship, incorporating [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/population.svg] to represent the population growth rate.

sections.title: Visualizing the Solution: Direction Fields
lecture_lines: Slope fields show the landscape of change.
Every point dictates a tangent vector's direction.
Follow the stream to visualize the solution.
animations: Populate grid with light gray vectors '#808080'.
Animate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stream.svg] tracer point following grid vectors along a curve path.
Pulse tracer color '#FFFFFF' as it flows through the field.

sections.title: The Role of Initial Conditions
lecture_lines: General solutions describe a family of curves.
Initial conditions anchor us to one path.
Like an archer, we pick our starting state.
animations: Display a family of curves in '#555555' with an archer icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/archer.svg] representing the starting position.
Place a glowing initial point in '#FFD700' and draw solution curve in '#00FF00', as if aiming with a bow [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bow.svg].
Move the initial point to change the curve, emphasizing the anchor effect.

sections.title: Summary & Real-World Application
lecture_lines: ODEs are the language of dynamic systems.
From pendulums to orbits, we predict change.
Mastering them unlocks the future state.
